plate_comment: The governor pressure controller's proportional term: the error x a numerator / denominator gain stepped by error breakpoints (e2m 8BB5 RE_PID_Error_Brkpt_0..2 above RE_PID_Switch_Temperature, 3..5 below it), added to governor_pressure_controller_output through cm848_limitGovernorPressureSolenoidDuty (was cm848_throttleGain_loadBased_calc)

The governor pressure controller's derivative term: governor_pressure_error_change x RE_K_D_Num / RE_K_D_Den, clamped to +-0x6400, into governor_pressure_controller_error_delta_term and added to the output (was cm848_throttleGain_velocityBased_calc)

The governor pressure controller's integral term: every governor_pressure_integral_period passes (RE_PID_Loop_Limit) the error sum / RE_PID_Error_Sum_Den, clamped to +-0x6400, becomes governor_pressure_integral_term and is added to the output; the sum is cleared (was cm848_throttleGain_timedAccumulate_update)
Clamps the controller output to governor_pressure_solenoid_duty_minimum .. _maximum (e2m RE_VFS_PWM_Minimum / Maximum) into governor_pressure_controller_output (was cm848_throttleSetpoint_limit)

End of the governor pressure sensor offset calibration: governor_pressure_sensor_zero_offset = the filtered sensor reading, or the limit it is beyond (governor_pressure_sensor_offset_minimum / _maximum, e2m RE_Transducer_Offset_Min / Max), with governor_pressure_sensor_calibration_flags; then drives the solenoid duty (inverted by governor_pressure_solenoid_duty_inversion) through the output driver table (was cm848_throttlePosition_clamp_update)

Boot initialization of the governor pressure control: two lookup caches to 2, the solenoid output channel enabled, governor_pressure_integral_period_counter loaded, governor_pressure_controller_output set to its start value (was initHpcr_HandlerRoutines)

The 48RE cruise governor pressure mode, run while condition_flags_1 bit 4 (e2m RE_Cruise_Active) follows cruise_control_engaged_flag: the target is RE_Cruise_Curve (pressure state 3), or the manual low curve (0x16) with the lever in 1 / 2. The 3-4 / 4-3 requests come from the RE_Cruise_3_4 / RE_Cruise_4_3 lines, or their exhaust brake copies with switch 12 on; then the cruise decel 4-3 / 3-4 requests (transmission_cruise_downshift_delay_timer / _upshift_) (was cm848_protectionStateTransitionCheck)

The low range converter lockup schedule: the 3rd / 4th gear low range lockup curves (e2m RE_Lockup_Curve_3 / 4_Low_Range, RE_Unlock_Curve_3_Low_Range) decide the lockup request (logical output 18) (was cm848_protectionCleanupHandler)

The low range converter unlock conditions: above the low range unlock curves (e2m RE_Unlock_Curve_3 / 4_Low_Range) it releases the converter clutch request and reloads converter_clutch_apply_delay_countdown (was cm848_protectionShutdownHandler)
The low range 3-4 / 4-3 requests (condition_eval bits 2 / 1) from e2m RE_Low_Range_3_4 / RE_Low_Range_4_3 (was cm848_protectionNormalHandler)
The normal (not cruise) 3-4 / 4-3 requests (condition_eval bits 2 / 1) from e2m RE_Normal_3_4 / RE_Normal_4_3, or their exhaust brake copies with switch 12 on (was cm848_protectionFuelDemandCheck)
